
===== No active hauling job is available for this crop, destination, and ticket date. =====

.filter(
                contract =>
                  contractIsOpen(contract) &&
                  clean(contract?.haulingJobId) ===
                    clean(job.id)
              );

            const customerCompatible =
              storedJobCustomerId === selectedCustomerId ||
              linkedContracts.some(
                contract =>
                  contractCustomerId(contract) === selectedCustomerId &&
                  (
                    !selectedCrop ||
                    contractCrop(contract) === selectedCrop
                  )
              ) ||
              (
                !storedJobCustomerId &&
                linkedContracts.length === 0
              );

            if (!customerCompatible) {
              return false;
            }
          }


          return true;

        }
      )

      .sort(
        (
          a,
          b
        ) =>
          clean(
            a?.deliveryStartDate ||
            a?.deliveryStart
          )
            .localeCompare(
              clean(
                b?.deliveryStartDate ||
                b?.deliveryStart
              )
            ) ||
          contractLabel(
            a
          )
            .localeCompare(
              contractLabel(
                b
              ),
              undefined,
              {
                numeric:
                  true,

                sensitivity:
                  "base"
              }
            )
      );


  if (
    !jobs.length
  ) {

    elements.contractSelect.disabled =
      true;


    blank.textContent =
      "No active hauling jobs";


    elements.contractSelect.appendChild(
      blank
    );


    elements.contractStatus.className =
      "contract-box warning";


    elements.contractStatus.textContent =
      "No active hauling job is available for this crop, destination, and ticket date.";


    state.selectedContract =
      null;


    return;

  }


  elements.contractSelect.disabled =
    false;


  blank.textContent =
    jobs.length ===
      1
      ? "Select hauling job"
      : `Select one of ${jobs.length} hauling jobs`;


  elements.contractSelect.appendChild(
    blank
  );


  jobs.forEach(
    job => {

      const option =
        document.createElement(
          "option"
        );


      option.value =
        job.id;


      option.textContent =
        haulingJobDropdownLabel(
          job
        );


      elements.contractSelect.appendChild(
        option
      );

    }
  );


  const validWanted =
    jobs.find(
      job =>
        job.id ===
        wantedId
    ) ||
    (
      jobs.length === 1
        ? jobs[0]
        : null
    );


  elements.contractSelect.value =
    validWanted?.id ||
    "";


  state.selectedContract =
    validWanted;


  elements.contractStatus.className =
    "contract-box good";


  elements.contractStatus.textContent =
    `${jobs.length} active hauling job${jobs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} available.`;


  updateReviewUI();

}


function applySelectedHaulingJob() {

  const job =
    state.haulingJobs.find(
      item =>
        item.id ===
        elements.contractSelect.value
    ) ||
    null;


  state.selectedContract =
    job;


  if (
    !job
  ) {

    updateReviewUI();

    return;

  }


  /*
    ========================================================
    CROP
    ========================================================
  */

  const crop =
    clean(
      job.crop ||
      job.commodity
    );


  if (
    crop
  ) {

    const cropNorm =
      normalize(
        crop
      );


    if (
      cropNorm.includes(
        "corn"
      )
    ) {

      elements.crop.value =
        "Corn";

    }
    else if (
      cropNorm.includes(
        "soy"
      )
    ) {

      elements.crop.value =
        "Soybeans";

    }
    else if (
      cropNorm.includes(
        "wheat"
      )
    ) {

      elements.crop.value =
        "Wheat";

    }

  }


  /*
    ========================================================
    DESTINATION / BUYER
    ========================================================
  */

  const locationId =
    clean(
      job.deliveryLocationId ||
      job.locationId ||
      job.destinationId
    );


  state.selectedLocation =
    state.locations.find(
      location =>
        location.id ===
        locationId
    ) ||
    null;


  elements.locationSelect.value =
    state.selectedLocation?.id ||
    locationId ||
    "";


  const buyerId =
    clean(
      job.buyerId ||
      state.selectedLocation?.buyerId
    );


  state.selectedBuyer =
    state.buyers.find(
      buyer =>
        buyer.id ===
        buyerId
    ) ||
    (
      buyerId
        ? {
            id:
              buyerId,

            name:
              clean(
                job.buy

===== hauling_job_not_assigned =====

 GROSS - SHRINK = NET CHECK
    ==========================================================
  */

  if (
    Math.abs(
      expected -
      net
    ) >
    0.02
  ) {

    elements.bushelCheck.className =
      "contract-box warning";


    elements.bushelCheck.textContent =
      `${gross.toFixed(2)} Gross - ${shrink.toFixed(2)} Shrink = ${expected.toFixed(2)} Net, but ticket shows ${net.toFixed(2)}.`;


    return false;

  }


  elements.bushelCheck.className =
    "contract-box good";


  elements.bushelCheck.textContent =
    `✓ ${gross.toFixed(2)} Gross - ${shrink.toFixed(2)} Shrink = ${net.toFixed(2)} Net Bushels.`;


  return true;

}


function currentReviewReasons() {

  updateSelectedReferences();


  const reasons =
    [];


  if (
    !state.selectedLocation
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "delivery_location_not_matched"
    );

  }


  /*
    Sold Under rules:

    - no selection = review
    - Unknown = review
    - real linked customer = resolved
  */
  if (
    !state.selectedCustomer
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "customer_not_matched"
    );

  }
  else if (
    state.selectedCustomer.unknown ===
      true
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "sold_under_requires_review"
    );

  }


  if (
    !clean(
      elements.crop.value
    )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "crop_not_matched"
    );

  }


  if (
    !state.selectedSource
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "grain_source_not_assigned"
    );

  }
  else if (
    clean(
      elements.crop.value
    ) &&
    clean(
      state.selectedSource.crop
    ) &&
    normalize(
      elements.crop.value
    ) !==
      normalize(
        state.selectedSource.crop
      )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "grain_source_crop_mismatch"
    );

  }


  if (
    !state.selectedContract
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "hauling_job_not_assigned"
    );

  }


  /*
    If a REAL Sold Under customer is selected,
    confirm that customer still has at least one
    OPEN contract linked to the selected hauling job.
  */
  if (
    state.selectedContract &&
    state.selectedCustomer &&
    state.selectedCustomer.unknown !==
      true
  ) {

    const validSoldUnder =
      state.contracts.some(
        contract =>
          contractIsOpen(
            contract
          ) &&
          clean(
            contract?.haulingJobId
          ) ===
            clean(
              state.selectedContract.id
            ) &&
          contractCustomerId(
            contract
          ) ===
            clean(
              state.selectedCustomer.id
            )
      );


    if (
      !validSoldUnder &&
      !haulingJobHasUnallocatedContractCapacity(
        state.selectedContract
      )
    ) {

      reasons.push(
        "sold_under_requires_review"
      );

    }

  }


  if (
    !clean(
      elements.ticketNumber.value
    )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_number_missing"
    );

  }


  if (
    !clean(
      elements.ticketDate.value
    )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_date_missing"
    );

  }


  if (
    !validateWeights()
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_weights_invalid"
    );

  }


  if (
    !validateBushels()
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_bushels_invalid"
    );

  }


  return Array.from(
    new Set(
      reasons
    )
  );

}


    function updateReviewUI() {

      if (
        !state.ticket
      ) {

        return;

      }


      const reasons =
        currentReviewReasons();


      const verified =
        reasons.length ===
        0;


      elements.statusPill.className =
        verified
          ? "status-pill good"
          : "status-pill review";


      elements.statusPill.textContent =
        verified
          ? "Verified"
          : "Needs Review";


      elements.reviewList.innerHTML =
        "";


      if (
        verified
      ) {

        elements.reviewBox.classList.remove(
          "show"
        );


        elements.saveBtn.textContent =
          state.saving
            ? "Saving…"
            : "Save & Verify Ticket";


        return;

      }


      elements.reviewBox.classList.add(
        "show"
      );


      reasons.forEach(
        reason => {

          const item =
            document.createElement(
              "li"
            );


          item.textContent =
            reviewLabel(
              reason
            );


          elements.reviewList.appendChild(
            item
          );

        }
      );


      elements.saveBtn.textContent =
        state.saving
          ? "Saving…"
          : "Save Ticket";

    }



    // ==========================================================
    // CURRENT DROPDOWN VALUES
    // ==========================================================

function updateSelectedReferences() {

  const customerValue =
    cle
s.filter(
          ticket => {
            if (
              ticket?.id ===
                ticketId
            ) {
              return false;
            }

            const candidateCustomerId =
              clean(
                ticket?.grainCustomerId ||
                ticket?.customerId
              );

            if (
              candidateCustomerId ===
                clean(selectedCustomer.id)
            ) {
              return false;
            }

            const candidateStatus =
              normalize(
                ticket?.validationStatus ||
                ticket?.status ||
                ""
              );

            const candidateReasons =
              Array.isArray(ticket?.reviewReasons)
                ? ticket.reviewReasons
                : [];

            const stillNeedsReview =
              candidateStatus === "needs_review" ||
              candidateStatus === "review" ||
              candidateStatus === "needs review" ||
              candidateReasons.length > 0;

            return (
              stillNeedsReview &&
              sameSoldUnderOcrEvidence(
                state.ticket,
                ticket
              )
            );
          }
        );


      let updatedCount =
        0;


      for (
        const ticket of
        matches
      ) {

        const existingReasons =
          Array.isArray(
            ticket.reviewReasons
          )
            ? ticket.reviewReasons
            : [];


        const matchingJob =
          matchingHaulingJobForReviewTicket(ticket);

        const reviewReasons =
          existingReasons.filter(reason => {
            const key = String(reason || "");
            if (customerReviewReasons.has(key)) return false;
            if (matchingJob && key === "hauling_job_not_assigned") return false;
            return true;
          });


        try {

          if (matchingJob) {
            await syncSoldUnderToHaulingJob(
              matchingJob,
              selectedCustomer,
              ticketId
            );
          }

          await updateDoc(
            doc(
              db,
              "grain_tickets",
              ticket.id
            ),
            {
              customerId:
                selectedCustomer.id,

              customerName:
                selectedCustomer.name,

              haulingJobId:
                matchingJob?.id ||
                ticket?.haulingJobId ||
                null,

              haulingJobName:
                matchingJob
                  ? contractLabel(matchingJob)
                  : (ticket?.haulingJobName || null),

              haulingJobMatched:
                Boolean(matchingJob || ticket?.haulingJobId),

              matchingHaulingJobIds:
                matchingJob
                  ? [matchingJob.id]
                  : (
                      Array.isArray(ticket?.matchingHaulingJobIds)
                        ? ticket.matchingHaulingJobIds
                        : []
                    ),

              reviewReasons,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedFromTicketId:
                ticketId,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectionSource:
                sourceEvidence.account
                  ? "exact_ocr_customer_account"
                  : "exact_ocr_customer_text",

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedAt:
                serverTimestamp(),

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedByUid:
                state.user?.uid ||
                null,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedByName:
                state.user?.displayName ||
                state.user?.email ||
                "FarmVista User",

              updatedAt:
                serverTimestamp()
            }
          );


          ticket.customerId =
            selectedCustomer.id;

          ticket.customerName =
            selectedCustomer.name;

          if (matchingJob) {
            ticket.haulingJobId = matchingJob.id;
            ticket.haulingJobName = contractLabel(matchingJob);
            ticket.haulingJobMatched = true;
            ticket.matchingHaulingJobIds = [matchingJob.id];
          }

          ticket.reviewReasons =
            reviewReasons;

          updatedCount++;

        }
        catch (
          error
        ) {

          console.warn(
            "[Grain Ticket Detail] Matching Sold Under review ticket could not be updated:",
            {
              ticketId:
                ticket.id,
              error
            }
          );

        }

      }


      return updatedCount;

    }

  }
  else {

    state.selectedCustomer = {
      id: null,

      unknown: true
    };


    elements.customerSelect.value =
      "__unknown__";

  }

}
else {

  state.selectedCustomer = {
    id: null,
    name: "Unknown",
    unknown: true
  };


  elements.customerSelect.value =
    "__unknown__";

}


  /*
    ========================================================
    DRIVER
    ========================================================
  */

  elements.driverName.textContent =

    "success"
  );

          "This grain ticket could not be found."
        );

      }


      state.ticket = {

        id:
          snapshot.id,

        ...snapshot.data()

      };

    }

    // ==========================================================
    // LOAD TICKET
    // ==========================================================

    async function loadTicket() {

      if (
        !ticketId
      ) {

        throw new Error(
          "No grain ticket ID was provided."
        );

      }


      const snapshot =
        await getDoc(
          doc(
            db,
            "grain_tickets",
            ticketId
          )
        );


      if (
        !snapshot.exists()
      ) {

        throw new Error(
          "This grain ticket could not be found."
        );

      }


      state.ticket = {

        id:
          snapshot.id,

        ...snapshot.data()

      };

    }



    // ==========================================================
    // LOAD LINKED LOADOUT
    // ==========================================================

    async function loadLinkedLoadout() {

      state.loadout =
        null;


      const ticket =
        state.ticket ||
        {};


      const savedLoadoutId =
        clean(
          ticket.loadoutId ||
          ticket.loadOutId ||
          ticket.grainLoadoutId ||
          ticket.loadId
        );


      const savedLoadNumber =
        clean(
          ticket.loadNumber
        );


      const ticketNumber =
        clean(
          ticket.ticketNumber
        );


      /*
        IMPORTANT — EXPLICIT LINKS ONLY

        This detail page must NEVER guess which dispatch load belongs
        to a grain ticket.

        Safe relationships are limited to:

          1) ticket.loadoutId -> exact grain_loadouts document
          2) grain_loadouts.grainTicketId -> this exact ticket ID
          3) ticket.loadNumber -> one unique, exact FarmVista load number

        We intentionally DO NOT match by:
          - elevator ticket number
          - driver
          - destination
          - customer
          - buyer
          - crop
          - contract
          - ticket date
          - load date
          - created time / time proximity

        Those values are useful for humans reviewing the ticket, but
        they are not a safe key for creating a permanent relationship.

        The scan / dispatch workflow is responsible for creating the
        real ticket-to-load link. This page may only repair the missing
        backlink on the opposite document after an explicit relationship
        already exists.
      */


      async function syncExplicitLink(
        load,
        matchReason
      ) {

        if (
          !load
        ) {

          return false;

        }


        const existingLoadTicketId =
          clean(
            load.grainTicketId ||
            load.ticketId
          );


        /
 ${shrink.toFixed(2)} Shrink = ${net.toFixed(2)} Net Bushels.`;


  return true;

}


function currentReviewReasons() {

  updateSelectedReferences();

    [];

    !state.selectedLocation
  ) {

      "delivery_location_not_matched"
    );

    ) !==
      normalize(

      )
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "grain_source_crop_mismatch"
    );

  }

    !state.selectedContract
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "hauling_job_not_assigned"
    );

  }

    If a REAL Sold Under customer is selected,
    confirm that customer still has at least one
    OPEN contract linked to the selected hauling job.

  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_weights_invalid"
    );

  }


  if (
    !validateBushels()
  ) {

    reasons.push(
      "ticket_bushels_invalid"
    );

  }


  return Array.from(
    new Set(
      reasons
    )
  );

}


    function updateReviewUI() {

      if (
        !state.ticket
      ) {

        return;

      }


      const reasons =
        currentReviewReasons();


      const verified =
        reasons.length ===
        0;


      elements.statusPill.className =
        verified
          ? "status-pill good"
          : "status-pill review";


      elements.statusPill.textContent =
        verified
          ? "Verified"
          : "Needs Review";


      elements.reviewList.innerHTML =
        "";


      if (
        verified
      ) {

        elements.reviewBox.classList.remove(
          "show"
        );


        elements.saveBtn.textContent =
          state.saving
            ? "Saving…"
            : "Save & Verify Ticket";


        return;

      }


      elements.reviewBox.classList.add(
        "show"
      );


      reasons.forEach(
        reason => {

          const item =
            document.createElement(
              "li"
            );


          item.textContent =
            reviewLabel(
              reason
            );


          elements.reviewList.appendChild(
            item
          );

        }
      );


      elements.saveBtn.textContent =
        state.saving
          ? "Saving…"
          : "Save Ticket";

    }

                    state.selectedContract
                  )
                : null,

            haulingJobLabel:
              state.selectedContract
                ? contractLabel(
                    state.selectedContract
                  )
                : null,


            updatedAt:
              serverTimestamp()

          };


          awa

===== customerId: =====

     ) ||
              null,

            grainTicketId:
              ticketId,

            ticketNumber:
              payload.ticketNumber ||
              null,

            createdAt:
              serverTimestamp(),

            updatedAt:
              serverTimestamp()

          }
        );


        transaction.update(
          ticketRef,
          {

            ...payload,

            inventoryPosted:
              true,

            inventoryPostedType:
              "grain_bag",

            inventoryPostedBushels:
              ticketBushels,

            inventoryPostedFeet:
              feetPicked,

            inventoryMovementId:
              pickupRef.id,

            inventoryPostedAt:
              serverTimestamp()

          }
        );


        return;

      }


      throw new Error(
        "The selected grain source type is not supported."
      );

    }
  );

}

    async function syncSoldUnderToHaulingJob(
      job,
      selectedCustomer,
      sourceTicketId = ticketId
    ) {

      if (
        !job?.id ||
        !selectedCustomer?.id ||
        selectedCustomer?.unknown === true
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const linkedOpenContracts =
        state.contracts.filter(
          contract =>
            contractIsOpen(contract) &&
            clean(contract?.haulingJobId) === clean(job.id)
        );

      const linkedCustomerIds =
        new Set(
          linkedOpenContracts
            .map(contractCustomerId)
            .filter(Boolean)
        );

      /* Do not override a job that has contracts for a different customer. */
      if (
        linkedCustomerIds.size > 0 &&
        !linkedCustomerIds.has(clean(selectedCustomer.id))
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      const patch = {
        customerId: selectedCustomer.id,
        grainCustomerId: selectedCustomer.id,
        customerName: selectedCustomer.name,
        soldUnderSource: "grain_ticket_review",
        soldUnderLearnedFromTicketId: sourceTicketId,
        soldUnderLearnedAt: serverTimestamp(),
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp()
      };

      await updateDoc(
        doc(db, "grain_hauling_jobs", job.id),
        patch
      );

      Object.assign(job, patch);
      return true;
    }


    function matchingHaulingJobForReviewTicket(ticket) {
      const existingId = clean(ticket?.haulingJobId);
      if (existingId) {
        const existing =
          state.haulingJobs.find(job => clean(job.id) === existingId) || null;
        if (existing) return existing;
      }

      const crop = normalize(ticket?.crop);
      const locationId = clean(
        ticket?.deliveryLocationId ||
        ticket?.destinationId
      );
      const ticketDate = clean(ticket?.ticketDate);

      const matches = state.haulingJobs.filter(job => {
        if (job?.active === false || job?.voided === true) return false;

        const status = normalize(job?.status);
        if (
          status.includes("void") ||
          status.includes("closed") ||
          status.includes("cancel") ||
          status.includes("complete")
        ) return false;

        if (
          crop &&
          normalize(job?.crop || job?.commodity) !== crop
        ) return false;

        const jobLocationId = clean(
          job?.deliveryLocationId ||
          job?.locationId ||
          job?.destinationId
        );
        if (locationId && jobLocationId && jobLocationId !== locationId) return false;

        const start = clean(job?.deliveryStartDate || job?.deliveryStart);
        const end = clean(job?.deliveryEndDate || job?.deliveryEnd);
        if (ticketDate && start && ticketDate < start) return false;
        if (ticketDate && end && ticketDate > end) return false;
        return true;
      });

      return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0] : null;
    }


    // ==========================================================
    // BULK SOLD UNDER CORRECTION FOR REVIEW TICKETS
    // ==========================================================

    function normalizedSoldUnderOcr(
      value
    ) {

      return clean(
        value
      )
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(
          /[^a-z0-9]+/g,
          ""
        );

    }


    function soldUnderOcrEvidence(
      ticket
    ) {

      const storedCustomerId =
        clean(
          ticket?.grainCustomerId ||
          ticket?.customerId
        );

      const hasResolvedCustomer =
        Boolean(
          storedCustomerId &&
          state.customers.some(
            customer =>
              clean(customer?.id) ===
              storedCustomerId
          )
        );

      const unresolvedStoredCustomer =
        !hasResolvedCustomer
          ? (
              ticket?.customerAccount ||
              ticket?.custom
      return false;
            }

            const candidateStatus =
              normalize(
                ticket?.validationStatus ||
                ticket?.status ||
                ""
              );

            const candidateReasons =
              Array.isArray(ticket?.reviewReasons)
                ? ticket.reviewReasons
                : [];

            const stillNeedsReview =
              candidateStatus === "needs_review" ||
              candidateStatus === "review" ||
              candidateStatus === "needs review" ||
              candidateReasons.length > 0;

            return (
              stillNeedsReview &&
              sameSoldUnderOcrEvidence(
                state.ticket,
                ticket
              )
            );
          }
        );


      let updatedCount =
        0;


      for (
        const ticket of
        matches
      ) {

        const existingReasons =
          Array.isArray(
            ticket.reviewReasons
          )
            ? ticket.reviewReasons
            : [];


        const matchingJob =
          matchingHaulingJobForReviewTicket(ticket);

        const reviewReasons =
          existingReasons.filter(reason => {
            const key = String(reason || "");
            if (customerReviewReasons.has(key)) return false;
            if (matchingJob && key === "hauling_job_not_assigned") return false;
            return true;
          });


        try {

          if (matchingJob) {
            await syncSoldUnderToHaulingJob(
              matchingJob,
              selectedCustomer,
              ticketId
            );
          }

          await updateDoc(
            doc(
              db,
              "grain_tickets",
              ticket.id
            ),
            {
              customerId:
                selectedCustomer.id,

              customerName:
                selectedCustomer.name,

              haulingJobId:
                matchingJob?.id ||
                ticket?.haulingJobId ||
                null,

              haulingJobName:
                matchingJob
                  ? contractLabel(matchingJob)
                  : (ticket?.haulingJobName || null),

              haulingJobMatched:
                Boolean(matchingJob || ticket?.haulingJobId),

              matchingHaulingJobIds:
                matchingJob
                  ? [matchingJob.id]
                  : (
                      Array.isArray(ticket?.matchingHaulingJobIds)
                        ? ticket.matchingHaulingJobIds
                        : []
                    ),

              reviewReasons,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedFromTicketId:
                ticketId,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectionSource:
                sourceEvidence.account
                  ? "exact_ocr_customer_account"
                  : "exact_ocr_customer_text",

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedAt:
                serverTimestamp(),

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedByUid:
                state.user?.uid ||
                null,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedByName:
                state.user?.displayName ||
                state.user?.email ||
                "FarmVista User",

              updatedAt:
                serverTimestamp()
            }
          );


          ticket.customerId =
            selectedCustomer.id;

          ticket.customerName =
            selectedCustomer.name;

          if (matchingJob) {
            ticket.haulingJobId = matchingJob.id;
            ticket.haulingJobName = contractLabel(matchingJob);
            ticket.haulingJobMatched = true;
            ticket.matchingHaulingJobIds = [matchingJob.id];
          }

          ticket.reviewReasons =
            reviewReasons;

          updatedCount++;

        }
        catch (
          error
        ) {

          console.warn(
            "[Grain Ticket Detail] Matching Sold Under review ticket could not be updated:",
            {
              ticketId:
                ticket.id,
              error
            }
          );

        }

      }


      return updatedCount;

    }

            const key = String(reason || "");
            if (customerReviewReasons.has(key)) return false;
            if (matchingJob && key === "hauling_job_not_assigned") return false;
            return true;
          });


        try {

          if (matchingJob) {
            await syncSoldUnderToHaulingJob(
              matchingJob,
              selectedCustomer,
              ticketId
            );
          }

          await updateDoc(
            doc(
              db,
              "grain_tickets",
              ticket.id
            ),
            {
              customerId:
                selectedCustomer.id,

              customerName:
                selectedCustomer.name,

              haulingJobId:
                matchingJob?.id ||
                ticket?.haulingJobId ||
                null,

              haulingJobName:
                matchingJob
                  ? contractLabel(matchingJob)
                  : (ticket?.haulingJobName || null),

              haulingJobMatched:
                Boolean(matchingJob || ticket?.haulingJobId),

              matchingHaulingJobIds:
                matchingJob
                  ? [matchingJob.id]
                  : (
                      Array.isArray(ticket?.matchingHaulingJobIds)
                        ? ticket.matchingHaulingJobIds
                        : []
                    ),

              reviewReasons,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedFromTicketId:
                ticketId,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectionSource:
                sourceEvidence.account
                  ? "exact_ocr_customer_account"
                  : "exact_ocr_customer_text",

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedAt:
                serverTimestamp(),

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedByUid:
                state.user?.uid ||
                null,

              soldUnderBulkCorrectedByName:
                state.user?.displayName ||
                state.user?.email ||
                "FarmVista User",

              updatedAt:
                serverTimestamp()
            }
          );


          ticket.customerId =
            selectedCustomer.id;

          ticket.customerName =
            selectedCustomer.name;

          if (matchingJob) {
            ticket.haulingJobId = matchingJob.id;
            ticket.haulingJobName = contractLabel(matchingJob);
            ticket.haulingJobMatched = true;
            ticket.matchingHaulingJobIds = [matchingJob.id];
          }

          ticket.reviewReasons =
            reviewReasons;

          updatedCount++;

        }
        catch (
          error
        ) {

          console.warn(
            "[Grain Ticket Detail] Matching Sold Under review ticket could not be updated:",
            {
              ticketId:
                ticket.id,
              error
            }
          );

        }

      }


      return updatedCount;

    }


    // ==========================================================
    // SAVE / APPROVE
    // ==========================================================

    async function saveTicket(
      event
    ) {

      event.preventDefault();


      if (
        state.saving
      ) {

        return;

      }


      clearMessage();


      updateSelectedReferences();


      const reviewReasons =
        currentReviewReasons();


      const verified =
        reviewReasons.length ===
        0;


const selectedCustomer =
  state.selectedCustomer;


const customerIsUnknown =
  selectedCustomer?.unknown ===
    true;


      const selectedSource =
        state.selectedSource;


      const selectedLocation =
        state.selectedLocation;


      const selectedBuyer =
        state.select
om a Field to generic Active Harvest.
          */

            selectedSource?.fieldId ||
            null,

            selectedSource?.fieldName ||

            selectedSource?.fieldId ||
            null,

          sourceFieldName:
            selectedSource?.fieldName ||
            null,

          grainSourceCropYear:
            selectedSource?.cropYear ||
            null,


          validationStatus:
            verified
              ? "verified"
              : "needs_review",

          haulingJobMatched:
            matchingHaulingJobIds.length >
            0,

          matchingHaulingJobIds,

          /*
            Grain contract allocation.
            A uniquely resolved contract is posted immediately so the
            Contracts page includes this ticket in delivered bushels.
          */
          contractId:
            selectedGrainContract?.id ||
            null,

          contractNumber:
            selectedGrainContractNumber,

          contractAllocations:
            selectedGrainContract
              ? [
                  {
                    contractId:
                      selectedGrainContract.id,

                    contractNumber:
                      selectedGrainContractNumber,

                    bushels:
                      ticketNetBushels
                  }
                ]
              : [],

            selectedGrainContract

                  state.selectedContract

              : null,

reviewReasons,


/*

*/
